say:1:1121129001:1.text: Dura above! You guys are finally here!
say:1:1121129001:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，你们总算来了。

say:2:1121129002:1.text: This is remarkable... If I may ask, do the temple members think the sudden appearance of the statues has something to do with the Hypogean Rift in the temple?
say:2:1121129002:1.source_cn: 还真是不得了啊……冒昧问一句，圣堂觉得女神像的突然出现...

say:3:1121129003:2.text: Disturbing murmurings can constantly be heard from the depths of the Hypogean Rift, but we manage to prevent those sinful words from taking hold of our souls by always keeping Dura's guidance in mind.
say:3:1121129003:2.source_cn: 恶魔裂隙底部始终传来让人不安的碎语，但我们牢记艾雅的教...

say:4:1121129004:1.text: Besides, the rift's condition has been stable. There are no changes, except for the sudden appearance of these two statues.
say:4:1121129004:1.source_cn: 除此之外，裂隙情况稳定，没有变化——除了这两座突然出现...

say:5:1121129005:1.text: All the acolytes on duty heard a rhythmic chanting before the statues appeared. Although they didn't hear the sound clearly, they were certain it wasn't a prayer to Dura.
say:5:1121129005:1.source_cn: 神像出现之前，值守的修士与修女都有听到韵律的吟诵声，虽...

say:6:1121129006:1.text: Hmm, the statues that appeared out of nowhere and a rhythmic chanting—this part matches with the situation in Holistone...
say:6:1121129006:1.source_cn: 嗯，突然降临的石像，有规律的声音，这部分的情况都与圣石...

say:8:1121129007:2.text: Did you guys see a purplish-red light?
say:8:1121129007:2.source_cn: 请问，你们有看到紫红色的光芒吗？

say:9:1121129008:1.text: My fellow acolytes didn't mention seeing any unusual light, but...
say:9:1121129008:1.source_cn: 我的兄弟姊妹没有提到异常的亮光，但……

say:10:1121129009:1.text: Hold on... Are you Archon Talene?
say:10:1121129009:1.source_cn: 咦，塔琳殿下……？您是塔琳殿下吗？！

say:12:1121129011:0.text: It's really you! <style="highlight">Talene, the Celestial who oversees the Flame of Purity</style>... I never thought we'd be blessed with the visit of a Celestial again! This is a gift from Dura!

say:13:1121129012:0.text: Celestial... Are you talking about me?

say:14:1121129013:0.text: You completely match the description in the codex—you shine as brightly as the sun and burn as fiercely as flames. Those in your presence feel like they are basking in the sunlight. These are the signs of your divine power!
say:14:1121129013:0.source_cn: 您怎么了？您的身姿与圣堂典籍中所记载的完全一致，如烈日...

choice_prompt:15:1121129013.text: You completely match the description in the codex—you shine as brightly as the sun and burn as fiercely as flames. Those in your presence feel like they are basking in the sunlight. These are the signs of your divine power!
choice_prompt:15:1121129013.source_cn: 您怎么了？您的身姿与圣堂典籍中所记载的完全一致，如烈日般耀眼，如火焰般热烈，身临之处，仿佛让人沐于阳光——这都是您神力的证明！

say:16:1121129014:1.text: But we detected a Hypogean's aura within Talene...
say:16:1121129014:1.source_cn: 还有一件事，说出来可能有些冒犯，但在塔琳身上发现了奇怪...

say:17:1121129015:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> verified it with magic, so the result can't be wrong. Does the Temple Codex mention anything related to this?
say:17:1121129015:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> verified it with magic, so the result can't be wrong. Does the Temple Codex mention anything related to this?
say:17:1121129015:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> verified it with magic, so the result can't be wrong. Does the Temple Codex mention anything related to this?

say:18:1121129016:2.text: What? No... That's impossible! Celestials and Hypogeans are arch-enemies. According to the scripture, Talene abhors evil, having pursued Hypogeans all by herself to the ends of the continent.
say:18:1121129016:2.source_cn: 什么？不……这不可能！半神与恶魔不共戴天，而在记载中，...

say:19:1121129017:1.source_cn: 你们说她身上有恶魔的气息，这绝无可能！

say:20:1121129018:2.text: Thank you for defending me, but they aren't lying. I've lost all memories of my past.
say:20:1121129018:2.source_cn: 感谢你的信任，但他们没有欺骗你。我失去了过往的记忆。

say:21:1121129019:1.text: My name is indeed Talene, but I know nothing about my identity...
say:21:1121129019:1.source_cn: 我确实叫塔琳，但并不知道自己的身份……

say:22:1121129020:1.text: What? What on earth happened that could make you, a Celestial, lose your memory? T-this is...
say:22:1121129020:1.source_cn: 什么……？您身上究竟发生了什么事，竟然能让一位半神失去...

say:23:1121129021:2.text: Don't worry about me. Right now, the townsfolk of Holistone are in a state of fear and unease and the Heroic Order is in chaos.
say:23:1121129021:2.source_cn: 不必在意我的事情，我之前看到圣石镇居民惊恐不安，骑士团...

say:24:1121129022:1.text: As much as I want to retrieve what I've lost, helping other people is more pressing at the moment.
say:24:1121129022:1.source_cn: 虽然想寻回失去的东西，但此时此刻，让大家心安才是更为紧...

say:25:1121129023:1.text: Archon Talene... you're as generous and benevolent as described. I'll vouch for your identity on behalf of the temple.
say:25:1121129023:1.source_cn: 塔琳殿下……您的大度与仁慈的确与记载中一模一样。以圣堂...

say:26:1121129024:1.text: Please come with me. The two statues are in the temple. In the name of Dura, we must uncover the source of this wicked deception!
say:26:1121129024:1.source_cn: 请跟我来吧，那两座女神像就在神殿中。以艾雅的名义，必须...

choice:15:0:1.source_cn: 怪不得塔琳所到之处气温会升高

choice:15:1:2.text: But she has a Hypogean aura...
choice:15:1:2.source_cn: 抱歉，但她身上有恶魔的气息
choice:15:1:2.male: But she has a Hypogean aura...
choice:15:1:2.female: But she has a Hypogean aura...
